# MuiAD

> Self-hosted ad network for the MCP era. Your AI coding agent creates zones, generates creatives, places ads, moderates with Workers AI, and optimizes performance — all inside your own Cloudflare account. No ad fees.

- Site: https://muiad.meathill.com
- Demo admin: https://admin.muiad.meathill.com
- MCP endpoint: https://api.muiad.meathill.com/mcp
- Repo: https://github.com/meathill/mui-ad
- Author: Meathill Studio (https://meathill.com)

## MCP access

Generate a per-user API key (`muiad_…`) in admin → API keys, then:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http muiad https://api.muiad.meathill.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer muiad_YOUR_KEY"
```

Discovery card: https://muiad.meathill.com/.well-known/mcp.json
serverInfo.name: `muiad`

Cursor / Claude Desktop / Zed: see AGENT_GUIDE.

## What it does

- Scan matching ad zones across the marketplace (`muiad_scan_zones`)
- Register products and upload banner assets to self-hosted R2
- Create ads and attach them to multiple zones (`muiad_create_ad`)
- Workers AI text + image moderation (fail-closed)
- Performance dashboard + pause/resume (`muiad_list_ads_performance`, `muiad_set_ad_status`)
- Full attribution: impressions, clicks, conversions, unique visitors
